description: Amazon Web Services Support App in Slack You can use the Amazon Web Services Support App in Slack API to manage your support cases in Slack for your Amazon Web…

subcommands.name: create-slack-channel-configuration
subcommands.description: Creates a Slack channel configuration for your Amazon Web Services account.    You can add up to 5 Slack workspaces for your account.

options.name: --channel-id
options.description: The channel ID in Slack. This ID identifies a channel within a Slack workspace

options.name: --channel-name
options.description: The name of the Slack channel that you configure for the Amazon Web Services Support App

options.name: --channel-role-arn
options.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of an IAM role that you want to use to perform operations on Amazon Web Services.

options.name: --notify-on-add-correspondence-to-case
options.description: Whether you want to get notified when a support case has a new correspondence

options.name: --no-notify-on-add-correspondence-to-case
options.description: Whether you want to get notified when a support case has a new correspondence

options.name: --notify-on-case-severity
options.description: The case severity for a support case that you want to receive notifications.

options.name: --notify-on-create-or-reopen-case
options.description: Whether you want to get notified when a support case is created or reopened

options.name: --no-notify-on-create-or-reopen-case
options.description: Whether you want to get notified when a support case is created or reopened

options.name: --notify-on-resolve-case
options.description: Whether you want to get notified when a support case is resolved

options.name: --no-notify-on-resolve-case
options.description: Whether you want to get notified when a support case is resolved

options.name: --team-id
options.description: The team ID in Slack. This ID uniquely identifies a Slack workspace, such as T012ABCDEFG

options.name: --cli-input-json
options.description: Performs service operation based on the JSON string provided. The JSON string follows the format provided by ``--generate-cli-skeleton``.
